# Generated packs — do not edit by hand

Everything in `packs/` is generated from `guide/brand-guide-v2.1.md` (+ `guide/carried-from-brand-lock-v1.3.md`). Brand Guide v2.1 §12: regenerate all three after every change to the guide.

| Pack | Where it goes |
|------|---------------|
| `nfl-brand/` | Claude skill. Zip the folder and upload in claude.ai → Settings → Capabilities → Skills (replaces the Brand Lock v1.3 skill). Keeps the logo files and `assets/`. |
| `gem-instructions-v2.1.md` | Gemini Gem "NFL Brand Writer" — setup steps at the top of the file. |
| `chatgpt/instructions-v2.1.md` | ChatGPT Project / custom GPT — setup steps at the top of the file. |
